title: Garage Strength Sprint Speed Program
author: Timi A.
desc: This is for intermediate to advanced athletes looking to increase sprint speed. This program is based on the video "Perfect Training Split For Sprint Speed" by garage strength. The program has 4 days, leg power day, athlete day, impulse day, and I added an upper body day based on another video by garage strength.
